from z3 import *

# ---------- Data ----------
# Locations
HA = "Haight-Ashbury"
FW = "Fisherman's Wharf"
RD = "Richmond District"
MD = "Mission District"
BV = "Bayview"

# Travel times (minutes) as given (asymmetric)
travel = {
    (HA, FW): 23, (FW, HA): 22,
    (HA, RD): 10, (RD, HA): 10,
    (HA, MD): 11, (MD, HA): 12,
    (HA, BV): 18, (BV, HA): 19,
    (FW, RD): 18, (RD, FW): 18,
    (FW, MD): 22, (MD, FW): 22,
    (FW, BV): 26, (BV, FW): 25,
    (RD, MD): 20, (MD, RD): 20,
    (RD, BV): 26, (BV, RD): 25,
    (MD, BV): 13, (BV, MD): 13,
}

# Friend data: (location, window_start, window_end, required_meeting_minutes)
# Times are minutes after 9:00AM
friends = {
    "Sarah":   (FW, 5*60+45, 8*60+30, 105),   # 2:45PM to 5:30PM
    "Mary":    (RD, 4*60,    10*60+15, 75),   # 1:00PM to 7:15PM
    "Helen":   (MD, 12*60+45,13*60+30, 30),   # 9:45PM to 10:30PM
    "Thomas":  (BV, 6*60+15, 9*60+45, 120),   # 3:15PM to 6:45PM
}

# ---------- Z3 Variables ----------
opt = Optimize()

# Boolean indicating whether we meet each friend
meet = {p: Bool(f"meet_{p}") for p in friends}

# Meeting start times (minutes after 9:00AM)
start = {p: Int(f"start_{p}") for p in friends}

# Order index (0..3) if we meet, -1 otherwise
order = {p: Int(f"order_{p}") for p in friends}

# ---------- Constraints ----------
for p, (loc, win_start, win_end, dur) in friends.items():
    # If we meet, start time must respect window and duration
    opt.add(If(meet[p],
               And(start[p] >= win_start,
                   start[p] + dur <= win_end,
                   start[p] >= 0),
               True))
    # Order domain
    opt.add(If(meet[p],
               And(order[p] >= 0, order[p] <= 3),
               order[p] == -1))

# No two meetings share the same order
people = list(friends.keys())
for i in range(len(people)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(people)):
        pi, pj = people[i], people[j]
        opt.add(Or(Not(meet[pi]), Not(meet[pj]), order[pi] != order[pj]))

# Travel constraints
for p in people:
    loc_p = friends[p][0]
    dur_p = friends[p][3]
    # If p is first meeting (order == 0) ensure we can travel from Haight
    opt.add(If(And(meet[p], order[p] == 0),
               start[p] >= travel[(HA, loc_p)],
               True))

# Pairwise ordering constraints for travel between meetings
for p in people:
    for q in people:
        if p == q:
            continue
        loc_p = friends[p][0]
        loc_q = friends[q][0]
        dur_p = friends[p][3]
        # If p before q (order difference 1) enforce travel time
        opt.add(If(And(meet[p], meet[q], order[p] + 1 == order[q]),
                   start[q] >= start[p] + dur_p + travel[(loc_p, loc_q)],
                   True))

# ---------- Objective ----------
opt.maximize(Sum([If(meet[p], 1, 0) for p in people]))

# ---------- Solve ----------
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    # Gather attended meetings
    attended = []
    for p in people:
        if m.evaluate(meet[p]):
            s = m.evaluate(start[p]).as_long()
            dur = friends[p][3]
            attended.append((s, p, friends[p][0], dur))
    # Sort by start time
    attended.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    # Build itinerary list
    itinerary = []

    # Helper to format time
    def fmt(t):
        # t minutes after 9:00AM
        abs_min = 9*60 + t
        hour24 = (abs_min // 60) % 24
        minute = abs_min % 60
        suffix = "AM" if hour24 < 12 else "PM"
        hour12 = hour24 % 12
        if hour12 == 0:
            hour12 = 12
        return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

    # Start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at {HA} at 9:00AM.")

    cur_loc = HA
    cur_time = 0  # minutes after 9:00AM

    for s, p, loc, dur in attended:
        # Travel
        travel_time = travel[(cur_loc, loc)]
        arrival = cur_time + travel_time
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        # Wait if needed
        if s > arrival:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(s)}.")
        # Meet
        end = s + dur
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {p} from {fmt(s)} to {fmt(end)}.")
        # Update current location and time
        cur_loc = loc
        cur_time = end

    # Print the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

from z3 import *

# ----- Data definitions -----
people = ["Ronald", "Patricia", "Laura", "Emily", "Mary"]
locations = {
    "Ronald": "Russian Hill",
    "Patricia": "Sunset District",
    "Laura": "North Beach",
    "Emily": "The Castro",
    "Mary": "Golden Gate Park"
}
# availability windows in minutes from midnight
def hm_to_min(h, m):
    return h * 60 + m

windows = {
    "Ronald": (hm_to_min(13,45), hm_to_min(17,15)),   # 1:45PM - 5:15PM
    "Patricia": (hm_to_min(9,15), hm_to_min(22,0)),  # 9:15AM - 10:00PM
    "Laura": (hm_to_min(12,30), hm_to_min(12,45)),   # 12:30PM - 12:45PM
    "Emily": (hm_to_min(16,15), hm_to_min(18,30)),   # 4:15PM - 6:30PM
    "Mary": (hm_to_min(15,0), hm_to_min(16,30))      # 3:00PM - 4:30PM
}
durations = {
    "Ronald": 105,
    "Patricia": 60,
    "Laura": 15,
    "Emily": 60,
    "Mary": 60
}

# Directed travel times (in minutes)
travel = {
    ("Financial District","Russian Hill"): 10,
    ("Financial District","Sunset District"): 31,
    ("Financial District","North Beach"): 7,
    ("Financial District","The Castro"): 23,
    ("Financial District","Golden Gate Park"): 23,
    ("Russian Hill","Financial District"): 11,
    ("Russian Hill","Sunset District"): 23,
    ("Russian Hill","North Beach"): 5,
    ("Russian Hill","The Castro"): 21,
    ("Russian Hill","Golden Gate Park"): 21,
    ("Sunset District","Financial District"): 30,
    ("Sunset District","Russian Hill"): 24,
    ("Sunset District","North Beach"): 29,
    ("Sunset District","The Castro"): 17,
    ("Sunset District","Golden Gate Park"): 11,
    ("North Beach","Financial District"): 8,
    ("North Beach","Russian Hill"): 4,
    ("North Beach","Sunset District"): 27,
    ("North Beach","The Castro"): 22,
    ("North Beach","Golden Gate Park"): 22,
    ("The Castro","Financial District"): 20,
    ("The Castro","Russian Hill"): 18,
    ("The Castro","Sunset District"): 17,
    ("The Castro","North Beach"): 20,
    ("The Castro","Golden Gate Park"): 11,
    ("Golden Gate Park","Financial District"): 26,
    ("Golden Gate Park","Russian Hill"): 19,
    ("Golden Gate Park","Sunset District"): 10,
    ("Golden Gate Park","North Beach"): 24,
    ("Golden Gate Park","The Castro"): 13
}

# Helper to fetch travel time with default large value if missing
def travel_time(a, b):
    return travel.get((a, b), 9999)

# ----- Z3 model -----
opt = Optimize()

# Boolean: whether we meet each person
meet = {p: Bool(f"meet_{p}") for p in people}
# Start time of meeting (int minutes from midnight)
start = {p: Int(f"start_{p}") for p in people}
# End time = start + duration
end = {p: Int(f"end_{p}") for p in people}
# Ordering booleans for each unordered pair
order = {}
for i in range(len(people)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(people)):
        p, q = people[i], people[j]
        order[(p,q)] = Bool(f"order_{p}_{q}")  # True means p before q

# Domain constraints
for p in people:
    opt.add(Implies(meet[p],
                    And(start[p] >= windows[p][0],
                        end[p] == start[p] + durations[p],
                        end[p] <= windows[p][1])))
    # If not meeting, start/end values irrelevant (but keep them bounded)
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[p]), start[p] == 0))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[p]), end[p] == 0))

# Travel from start location (Financial District) to first meeting
for p in people:
    travel_fd = travel_time("Financial District", locations[p])
    opt.add(Implies(meet[p], start[p] >= travel_fd))

# Pairwise ordering and travel constraints
for i in range(len(people)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(people)):
        p, q = people[i], people[j]
        o = order[(p,q)]
        # If both are met, exactly one ordering holds
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[p], meet[q]), Or(o, Not(o))))
        # If p before q
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[p], meet[q], o),
                        end[p] + travel_time(locations[p], locations[q]) <= start[q]))
        # If q before p
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[p], meet[q], Not(o)),
                        end[q] + travel_time(locations[q], locations[p]) <= start[p]))

# Objective: maximize number of meetings
opt.maximize(Sum([If(meet[p], 1, 0) for p in people]))

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    # Gather visited friends
    visited = [p for p in people if m.evaluate(meet[p])]
    # Sort by start time
    visited.sort(key=lambda p: m.evaluate(start[p]).as_long())
    
    # Helper to format time
    def fmt(mins):
        h = (mins // 60) % 12
        h = 12 if h == 0 else h
        m = mins % 60
        suffix = "AM" if mins < 12*60 else "PM"
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}{suffix}"
    
    itinerary = []
    # Start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Financial District at {fmt(hm_to_min(9,0))}.")
    cur_loc = "Financial District"
    cur_time = hm_to_min(9,0)
    
    for p in visited:
        loc = locations[p]
        travel_min = travel_time(cur_loc, loc)
        depart_time = m.evaluate(start[p]).as_long() - travel_min
        # If we need to wait before departing
        if depart_time > cur_time:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(depart_time)}.")
        # Travel statement
        arrival = depart_time + travel_min
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_min} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        # If we arrive early, wait until meeting start
        meet_start = m.evaluate(start[p]).as_long()
        if arrival < meet_start:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        meet_end = m.evaluate(end[p]).as_long()
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {p} from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
        # Update current location and time
        cur_loc = loc
        cur_time = meet_end
    
    # Print the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

    opt.add(Implies(meets[i], starts[i] + dur <= a_end))
    # If not meeting, start can be anything (unused)
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meets[i]), starts[i] == 0))

# Non‑overlap and travel constraints

    for j in range(i+1, n):
        name_i, loc_i, _, _, dur_i = friends[i]
        name_j, loc_j, _, _, dur_j = friends[j]
        travel_ij = travel[(loc_i, loc_j)]
        travel_ji = travel[(loc_j, loc_i)]

        # If both meetings happen, one must be before the other respecting travel time
        opt.add(Implies(And(meets[i], meets[j]),

    # Build list of meetings that are true

from z3 import *

# Helper to convert minutes since midnight to 12‑hour time string
def mins_to_str(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    minute = m % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Travel times (minutes) between locations
travel = {
    "Haight": {"Russian Hill": 17, "Fisherman's Wharf": 23, "Nob Hill": 15,
              "Golden Gate Park": 7, "Alamo Square": 5, "Pacific Heights": 12},
    "Russian Hill": {"Haight": 17, "Fisherman's Wharf": 7, "Nob Hill": 5,
                     "Golden Gate Park": 21, "Alamo Square": 15, "Pacific Heights": 7},
    "Fisherman's Wharf": {"Haight": 22, "Russian Hill": 7, "Nob Hill": 11,
                          "Golden Gate Park": 25, "Alamo Square": 20, "Pacific Heights": 12},
    "Nob Hill": {"Haight": 13, "Russian Hill": 5, "Fisherman's Wharf": 11,
                 "Golden Gate Park": 17, "Alamo Square": 11, "Pacific Heights": 8},
    "Golden Gate Park": {"Haight": 7, "Russian Hill": 19, "Fisherman's Wharf": 24,
                         "Nob Hill": 20, "Alamo Square": 10, "Pacific Heights": 16},
    "Alamo Square": {"Haight": 5, "Russian Hill": 13, "Fisherman's Wharf": 19,
                     "Nob Hill": 11, "Golden Gate Park": 9, "Pacific Heights": 10},
    "Pacific Heights": {"Haight": 11, "Russian Hill": 7, "Fisherman's Wharf": 13,
                        "Nob Hill": 8, "Golden Gate Park": 15, "Alamo Square": 10},
}

# Fixed data
start_time = 9 * 60  # 9:00 AM in minutes

friends = {
    "Anthony":   {"loc": "Alamo Square",   "avail_start": 7*60+45,   "avail_end": 19*60+45, "min_meet": 15},
    "Steven":    {"loc": "Golden Gate Park","avail_start": 8*60+30, "avail_end": 17*60+0,  "min_meet": 75},
    "Sandra":    {"loc": "Pacific Heights","avail_start": 14*60+45,"avail_end": 21*60+45,"min_meet": 45},
    "Stephanie": {"loc": "Russian Hill",   "avail_start": 20*60+0,  "avail_end": 20*60+45,"min_meet": 15},
    "Kevin":     {"loc": "Fisherman's Wharf","avail_start": 19*60+15,"avail_end": 21*60+45,"min_meet": 75},
    # Robert is intentionally omitted because his window cannot be satisfied.
}

# Z3 variables for start times of each meeting
starts = {name: Int(f"start_{name}") for name in friends}
ends   = {name: Int(f"end_{name}")   for name in friends}

s = Solver()

# Constraints for each friend
for name, data in friends.items():
    s.add(starts[name] >= data["avail_start"])
    s.add(ends[name]   == starts[name] + data["min_meet"])
    s.add(ends[name]   <= data["avail_end"])

# Chain the visits in the order: Anthony -> Steven -> Sandra -> Stephanie -> Kevin
order = ["Anthony", "Steven", "Sandra", "Stephanie", "Kevin"]
# Travel from start location (Haight) to first friend
first = order[0]
s.add(starts[first] >= start_time + travel["Haight"][friends[first]["loc"]])

# Travel between consecutive friends
for i in range(len(order)-1):
    cur = order[i]
    nxt = order[i+1]
    travel_time = travel[friends[cur]["loc"]][friends[nxt]["loc"]]
    s.add(starts[nxt] >= ends[cur] + travel_time)

# Ensure all times are within a reasonable day (optional)
for name in friends:
    s.add(starts[name] >= 0, ends[name] <= 24*60)

# Solve
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    itinerary = []
    # Start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Haight-Ashbury at {mins_to_str(start_time)}.")
    # Sequentially add travel, wait (if any), and meet statements
    prev_end = start_time
    prev_loc = "Haight"
    for name in order:
        loc = friends[name]["loc"]
        travel_time = travel[prev_loc][loc]
        arrive = m.evaluate(starts[name]).as_long() - friends[name]["min_meet"] + travel_time
        # Travel statement
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {mins_to_str(arrive)}.")
        # Wait if arrival is earlier than meeting start
        meet_start = m.evaluate(starts[name]).as_long()
        if arrive < meet_start:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {mins_to_str(meet_start)}.")
        # Meet statement
        meet_end = m.evaluate(ends[name]).as_long()
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} from {mins_to_str(meet_start)} to {mins_to_str(meet_end)}.")
        # Update for next leg
        prev_end = meet_end
        prev_loc = loc

    # Print the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

def fmt_time(offset):

    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"

    if travel_start is not None:
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], order[i] == 1),
                        start[i] >= travel_start))

# Objective: maximize number of meetings
opt.maximize(Sum([If(meet[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]))

    m = opt.model()
    # collect scheduled friends
    scheduled = []
    for i in range(n):
        if m.evaluate(meet[i]):
            scheduled.append({
                "idx": i,
                "order": m.evaluate(order[i]).as_long(),
                "start": m.evaluate(start[i]).as_long(),
                "name": friends[i]["name"],
                "loc": friends[i]["loc"],
                "duration": friends[i]["duration"]

    itinerary = []

from z3 import *

# Helper to convert minutes since 9:00 AM to 12‑hour time strings
def fmt(mins):
    total = 9*60 + mins  # absolute minutes from midnight
    hour = (total // 60) % 12
    hour = 12 if hour == 0 else hour
    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM" if total < 12*60 else "PM"
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Locations
CASTRO = "The Castro"
ALAMO = "Alamo Square"
UNION = "Union Square"
CHINATOWN = "Chinatown"

# Travel times (minutes) – symmetric where given, otherwise use listed direction
travel = {
    (CASTRO, ALAMO): 8,
    (CASTRO, UNION): 19,
    (CASTRO, CHINATOWN): 20,
    (ALAMO, CASTRO): 8,
    (ALAMO, UNION): 14,
    (ALAMO, CHINATOWN): 16,
    (UNION, CASTRO): 19,
    (UNION, ALAMO): 15,
    (UNION, CHINATOWN): 7,
    (CHINATOWN, CASTRO): 22,
    (CHINATOWN, ALAMO): 17,
    (CHINATOWN, UNION): 7,
}

# Meeting data
friends = {
    "Emily":   {"loc": ALAMO,       "win_start": 165, "win_end": 375, "dur": 105},
    "Barbara": {"loc": UNION,       "win_start": 465, "win_end": 555, "dur": 60},
    "William": {"loc": CHINATOWN,   "win_start": 495, "win_end": 600, "dur": 105},
}

opt = Optimize()

# Boolean variables indicating whether we meet each friend
meet = {name: Bool(f"meet_{name}") for name in friends}
# Integer start times (minutes after 9:00 AM) for each meeting
start = {name: Int(f"start_{name}") for name in friends}

# Add domain and availability constraints
for name, data in friends.items():
    opt.add(Implies(meet[name],
                    And(start[name] >= data["win_start"],
                        start[name] + data["dur"] <= data["win_end"])))
    # travel from the start location (The Castro) to the first meeting
    opt.add(Implies(meet[name],
                    start[name] >= travel[(CASTRO, data["loc"])]))

# Pairwise ordering constraints (if both meetings are selected they must not overlap and travel time is respected)
names = list(friends.keys())
for i in range(len(names)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(names)):
        a, b = names[i], names[j]
        loc_a, loc_b = friends[a]["loc"], friends[b]["loc"]
        dur_a, dur_b = friends[a]["dur"], friends[b]["dur"]
        travel_ab = travel[(loc_a, loc_b)]
        travel_ba = travel[(loc_b, loc_a)]
        # If both are met, enforce a before b OR b before a
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[a], meet[b]),
                        Or(start[a] + dur_a + travel_ab <= start[b],
                           start[b] + dur_b + travel_ba <= start[a])))

# Objective: maximize number of friends met
opt.maximize(Sum([If(meet[n], 1, 0) for n in names]))

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    # Gather selected meetings
    meetings = []
    for name in names:
        if m.evaluate(meet[name]):
            s = m.evaluate(start[name]).as_long()
            e = s + friends[name]["dur"]
            meetings.append((s, name, e))
    # Sort by start time
    meetings.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    # Build itinerary
    itinerary = []
    # start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at {CASTRO} at 9:00AM.")
    cur_loc = CASTRO
    cur_time = 0  # minutes after 9:00

    for s, name, e in meetings:
        # travel to meeting location
        travel_time = travel[(cur_loc, friends[name]["loc"])]
        arrive = cur_time + travel_time
        # add travel step
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {friends[name]['loc']} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        # wait if early
        if arrive < s:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(s)}.")
        # meeting
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} from {fmt(s)} to {fmt(e)}.")
        # update current location and time
        cur_loc = friends[name]["loc"]
        cur_time = e

    # Output the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

from z3 import *

# Helper functions
def parse_time(t):
    # t like "5:30PM"
    hour = int(t[:-5].split(":")[0])
    minute = int(t[:-5].split(":")[1])
    suffix = t[-2:]
    if suffix == "PM" and hour != 12:
        hour += 12
    if suffix == "AM" and hour == 12:
        hour = 0
    # minutes since 9:00 AM
    return hour * 60 + minute - 9 * 60

def minutes_to_str(m):
    total = m + 9 * 60  # convert back to absolute minutes of day
    hour = (total // 60) % 24
    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM"

    display_hour = hour % 12

from z3 import *

# Helper functions for time conversion
def hm_to_minutes(hm):
    # hm like "7:00PM"
    h, rest = hm.split(':')
    m = int(rest[:2])
    suffix = rest[2:]
    h = int(h)
    if suffix == 'PM' and h != 12:
        h += 12
    if suffix == 'AM' and h == 12:
        h = 0
    return h * 60 + m

def minutes_from_start(t):
    # minutes since 9:00 AM (which is 540 minutes from midnight)
    return t - 540

def minutes_to_str_from_start(m):
    total = 540 + m  # absolute minutes from midnight
    h = (total // 60) % 24
    mi = total % 60
    suffix = 'AM'
    if h >= 12:
        suffix = 'PM'
    if h == 0:
        h = 12
    elif h > 12:
        h -= 12
    return f"{h}:{mi:02d}{suffix}"

# Helper to convert minutes since midnight to 12h format string
def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

locations = {"Barbara": "Fisherman's Wharf",
             "Betty": "Presidio",
             "David": "Richmond District"}

               "Betty": 10 * 60 + 15,    # 10:15 AM
               "David": 13 * 60}         # 1:00 PM

             "Betty": 21 * 60 + 30,    # 9:30 PM

    ("Embarcadero", "Presidio"): 20,
    ("Embarcadero", "Richmond District"): 21,
    ("Embarcadero", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 6,
    ("Presidio", "Embarcadero"): 20,
    ("Presidio", "Richmond District"): 7,
    ("Presidio", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 19,
    ("Richmond District", "Embarcadero"): 19,
    ("Richmond District", "Presidio"): 7,
    ("Richmond District", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 18,

# ---------- Helper functions ----------
def time_to_min(t):
    # t like "7:15AM" or "12:00PM"
    h, rest = t.split(':')
    m = int(rest[:2])
    ampm = rest[2:]
    h = int(h)
    if ampm == 'PM' and h != 12:
        h += 12
    if ampm == 'AM' and h == 12:
        h = 0
    return h * 60 + m

def min_to_time(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mi = m % 60

def travel_time(src_idx, dst_idx):

    dst = "Pacific Heights" if dst_idx == -1 else locations[dst_idx]

from z3 import Optimize, Int, Distinct, Implies, If, sat

# Locations
locations = ["Bayview", "North Beach", "Presidio", "Haight-Ashbury", "Union Square"]

# Travel times (minutes) as a dictionary of dictionaries
travel = {
    "Bayview": {"North Beach": 21, "Presidio": 31, "Haight-Ashbury": 19, "Union Square": 17},
    "North Beach": {"Bayview": 22, "Presidio": 17, "Haight-Ashbury": 18, "Union Square": 7},
    "Presidio": {"Bayview": 31, "North Beach": 18, "Haight-Ashbury": 15, "Union Square": 22},
    "Haight-Ashbury": {"Bayview": 18, "North Beach": 19, "Presidio": 15, "Union Square": 17},
    "Union Square": {"Bayview": 15, "North Beach": 10, "Presidio": 24, "Haight-Ashbury": 18},
}

# Friend data
friends = [
    {"name": "Barbara", "loc": "North Beach", "avail_start": 285, "avail_end": 675, "meet_min": 60},
    {"name": "Margaret", "loc": "Presidio", "avail_start": 75,  "avail_end": 375, "meet_min": 30},
    {"name": "Kevin",    "loc": "Haight-Ashbury", "avail_start": 660, "avail_end": 705, "meet_min": 30},
    {"name": "Kimberly", "loc": "Union Square", "avail_start": 0,   "avail_end": 465, "meet_min": 30},
]

opt = Optimize()

# Decision variables
starts = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(len(friends))]
orders = [Int(f"order_{i}") for i in range(len(friends))]

# Domain constraints for orders
opt.add([order >= 0 for order in orders])
opt.add([order < len(friends) for order in orders])
opt.add(Distinct(orders))

# Availability and meeting duration constraints
for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(starts[i] >= f["avail_start"])
    opt.add(starts[i] + f["meet_min"] <= f["avail_end"])

# Travel constraints based on ordering
for i in range(len(friends)):
    for j in range(len(friends)):
        if i == j:
            continue
        # If i is before j, ensure enough travel time
        travel_time = travel[friends[i]["loc"]][friends[j]["loc"]]
        opt.add(Implies(orders[i] < orders[j],
                        starts[i] + friends[i]["meet_min"] + travel_time <= starts[j]))

# First meeting must be reachable from Bayview
for i in range(len(friends)):
    travel_time = travel["Bayview"][friends[i]["loc"]]
    opt.add(Implies(orders[i] == 0,
                    travel_time <= starts[i]))

# Objective: maximize number of meetings (all are mandatory here)
opt.maximize(sum([1 for _ in friends]))

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    # Extract schedule
    schedule = []
    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        schedule.append({
            "name": f["name"],
            "loc": f["loc"],
            "start": m[starts[i]].as_long(),
            "duration": f["meet_min"],
            "order": m[orders[i]].as_long()
        })
    # Sort by order
    schedule.sort(key=lambda x: x["order"])

    # Helper to format time (minutes since midnight)
    def fmt(mins_since_midnight):
        hour = (mins_since_midnight // 60) % 24
        minute = mins_since_midnight % 60
        suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
        hour12 = hour % 12
        if hour12 == 0:
            hour12 = 12
        return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

    # Build itinerary
    itinerary = []
    # Start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Bayview at {fmt(9*60)}.")
    current_loc = "Bayview"
    current_time = 0  # minutes after 9:00AM

    for entry in schedule:
        travel_time = travel[current_loc][entry["loc"]]
        arrival = current_time + travel_time
        # Wait if arriving early
        if arrival < entry["start"]:
            wait_until = entry["start"]
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(9*60 + wait_until)}.")
            arrival = entry["start"]
        # Travel statement
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {entry['loc']} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(9*60 + arrival)}.")
        # Meeting statement
        meet_start = entry["start"]
        meet_end = meet_start + entry["duration"]
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {entry['name']} from {fmt(9*60 + meet_start)} to {fmt(9*60 + meet_end)}.")
        # Update current location and time
        current_loc = entry["loc"]
        current_time = meet_end

    # Print the final itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

from z3 import *

# Helper functions
def time_to_str(minutes):
    total = 9 * 60 + minutes  # convert to minutes since midnight (9:00AM is base)
    hour = (total // 60) % 12
    hour = 12 if hour == 0 else hour
    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM" if total < 12 * 60 else "PM"
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Locations
loc_idx = {"Union Square": 0, "Mission": 1, "Bayview": 2, "Sunset": 3}
travel = {
    (0, 1): 14, (0, 2): 15, (0, 3): 26,
    (1, 0): 15, (1, 2): 15, (1, 3): 24,
    (2, 0): 17, (2, 1): 13, (2, 3): 23,
    (3, 0): 30, (3, 1): 24, (3, 2): 22,
}

# Friends data
friends = [
    {"name": "Rebecca", "loc": "Mission", "avail_start": 150, "avail_end": 675, "min_meet": 120},
    {"name": "Karen",    "loc": "Bayview", "avail_start": 225, "avail_end": 360, "min_meet": 120},
    {"name": "Carol",    "loc": "Sunset",  "avail_start": 75,  "avail_end": 165, "min_meet": 30},
]

# Z3 variables
solver = Optimize()
meet_vars = []
order_vars = []
start_vars = []
dur_vars = []

for i, f in enumerate(friends):
    meet = Bool(f"meet_{i}")
    order = Int(f"order_{i}")
    start = Int(f"start_{i}")   # minutes after 9:00
    dur = Int(f"dur_{i}")       # meeting duration in minutes

    meet_vars.append(meet)
    order_vars.append(order)
    start_vars.append(start)
    dur_vars.append(dur)

    # If we meet, enforce domain constraints
    solver.add(Implies(meet, And(order >= 0, order <= 2)))
    solver.add(Implies(meet, start >= f["avail_start"]))
    solver.add(Implies(meet, start + dur <= f["avail_end"]))
    solver.add(Implies(meet, dur >= f["min_meet"]))

    # If we don't meet, set dummy values
    solver.add(Implies(Not(meet), order == -1))
    solver.add(Implies(Not(meet), dur == 0))

# Distinct order for those we meet
for i in range(len(friends)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(friends)):
        solver.add(Implies(And(meet_vars[i], meet_vars[j]), order_vars[i] != order_vars[j]))

# Travel and sequencing constraints
for i in range(len(friends)):
    for j in range(len(friends)):
        if i == j:
            continue
        # If both meetings happen and i is before j in order
        cond = And(meet_vars[i], meet_vars[j], order_vars[i] < order_vars[j])
        travel_time = travel[(loc_idx[friends[i]["loc"]], loc_idx[friends[j]["loc"]])]
        solver.add(Implies(cond, start_vars[j] >= start_vars[i] + dur_vars[i] + travel_time))

# First meeting travel from Union Square
for i in range(len(friends)):
    travel_time = travel[(loc_idx["Union Square"], loc_idx[friends[i]["loc"]])]
    solver.add(Implies(And(meet_vars[i], order_vars[i] == 0), start_vars[i] >= travel_time))

# Objective: maximize number of friends met
solver.maximize(Sum([If(m, 1, 0) for m in meet_vars]))

# Solve

    m = solver.model()
    # Gather meetings that are selected
    selected = []
    for i, f in enumerate(friends):
        if m.evaluate(meet_vars[i]):
            selected.append({

                "loc": f["loc"],
                "order": m.evaluate(order_vars[i]).as_long(),
                "start": m.evaluate(start_vars[i]).as_long(),
                "end": m.evaluate(start_vars[i]).as_long() + m.evaluate(dur_vars[i]).as_long(),
            })
    # Sort by order

else:

from z3 import *
import itertools

# Helper to convert minutes since 9:00AM to 12‑hour format string
def mins_to_str(m):
    total = 9 * 60 + m  # absolute minutes from midnight
    hour = (total // 60) % 12
    hour = 12 if hour == 0 else hour
    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM" if (total // 60) % 24 < 12 else "PM"
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Locations indices
FW = 0
Presidio = 1
Richmond = 2
Financial = 3

# Travel time matrix (minutes) – symmetric as given
travel = [
    [0, 17, 18, 11],   # from Fisherman's Wharf
    [19, 0, 7, 23],   # from Presidio
    [18, 7, 0, 22],   # from Richmond District
    [10, 22, 21, 0]   # from Financial District
]

# Friends data
friends = ["Emily", "Joseph", "Melissa"]
loc_idx = [Presidio, Richmond, Financial]          # location of each friend
dur = [105, 120, 75]                               # required meeting minutes
avail_start = [435, 495, 405]                      # minutes after 9:00AM when friend becomes available
avail_end   = [720, 780, 765]                      # latest minute (after 9:00AM) when meeting must finish

solver = Solver()

# Decision variables
w = Int('w')                     # waiting time before first travel
meet0 = Int('meet0')             # start time of first meeting (minutes after 9:00AM)
meet1 = Int('meet1')             # start time of second meeting
meet2 = Int('meet2')             # start time of third meeting

solver.add(w >= 0, meet0 >= 0, meet1 >= 0, meet2 >= 0)

# Permutation booleans
perms = list(itertools.permutations([0, 1, 2]))
perm_vars = [Bool(f'perm_{i}') for i in range(len(perms))]

# Exactly one permutation is chosen
solver.add(Sum([If(p, 1, 0) for p in perm_vars]) == 1)

for pvar, perm in zip(perm_vars, perms):
    f0, f1, f2 = perm
    # travel segments
    tr0 = travel[FW][loc_idx[f0]]
    tr1 = travel[loc_idx[f0]][loc_idx[f1]]
    tr2 = travel[loc_idx[f1]][loc_idx[f2]]

    # Arrival times (expressed as arithmetic, not new variables)
    arr0 = w + tr0
    arr1 = meet0 + dur[f0] + tr1
    arr2 = meet1 + dur[f1] + tr2

    # Constraints that only apply when this permutation is selected
    solver.add(Implies(pvar,
        And(
            # first meeting
            meet0 >= arr0,
            meet0 >= avail_start[f0],
            meet0 + dur[f0] <= avail_end[f0],
            # second meeting
            meet1 >= arr1,
            meet1 >= avail_start[f1],
            meet1 + dur[f1] <= avail_end[f1],
            # third meeting
            meet2 >= arr2,
            meet2 >= avail_start[f2],
            meet2 + dur[f2] <= avail_end[f2]
        )
    ))

# Solve
if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    # Find selected permutation
    chosen_perm = None
    for pvar, perm in zip(perm_vars, perms):
        if m.eval(pvar):
            chosen_perm = perm
            break

    f0, f1, f2 = chosen_perm
    tr0 = travel[FW][loc_idx[f0]]
    tr1 = travel[loc_idx[f0]][loc_idx[f1]]
    tr2 = travel[loc_idx[f1]][loc_idx[f2]]

    w_val = m[w].as_long()
    meet0_val = m[meet0].as_long()
    meet1_val = m[meet1].as_long()
    meet2_val = m[meet2].as_long()

    # Build itinerary statements
    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Fisherman's Wharf at {mins_to_str(0)}.")
    if w_val > 0:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {mins_to_str(w_val)}.")
    # travel to first friend
    arr0 = w_val + tr0
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {['Presidio','Richmond District','Financial District'][f0]} in {tr0} minutes and arrive at {mins_to_str(arr0)}.")
    # meet first friend
    itinerary.append(f"You meet {friends[f0]} from {mins_to_str(meet0_val)} to {mins_to_str(meet0_val + dur[f0])}.")
    # travel to second friend
    arr1 = meet0_val + dur[f0] + tr1
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {['Presidio','Richmond District','Financial District'][f1]} in {tr1} minutes and arrive at {mins_to_str(arr1)}.")
    itinerary.append(f"You meet {friends[f1]} from {mins_to_str(meet1_val)} to {mins_to_str(meet1_val + dur[f1])}.")
    # travel to third friend
    arr2 = meet1_val + dur[f1] + tr2
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {['Presidio','Richmond District','Financial District'][f2]} in {tr2} minutes and arrive at {mins_to_str(arr2)}.")
    itinerary.append(f"You meet {friends[f2]} from {mins_to_str(meet2_val)} to {mins_to_str(meet2_val + dur[f2])}.")

    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible itinerary found.")

from z3 import *

# Helper to convert minutes since midnight to 12-hour format string
def mins_to_str(m):
    hour = (m // 60) % 24
    minute = m % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    hour12 = hour % 12
    if hour12 == 0:
        hour12 = 12
    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Fixed parameters (minutes since midnight)
START_TIME = 9 * 60                 # 9:00AM
BARBARA_START = 7 * 60 + 15        # 7:15AM
BARBARA_END = 22 * 60              # 10:00PM
TRAVEL_RH_PH = 7                   # travel time Russian Hill -> Pacific Heights

# Decision variables
meet_start = Int('meet_start')
meet_dur   = Int('meet_dur')   # meeting duration in minutes

s = Solver()

# Domain constraints
s.add(meet_start >= START_TIME + TRAVEL_RH_PH)   # cannot start before arriving
s.add(meet_start >= BARBARA_START)               # Barbara must be present
s.add(meet_dur >= 60)                            # minimum 60 minutes
s.add(meet_start + meet_dur <= BARBARA_END)      # must finish before she leaves

# Optional: keep meeting within the day (non‑negative)
s.add(meet_start >= 0, meet_dur >= 0)

# Check satisfiability
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    ms = m[meet_start].as_long()
    md = m[meet_dur].as_long()
    # Build itinerary statements
    itinerary = []
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Russian Hill at {mins_to_str(START_TIME)}.")
    arrival_time = START_TIME + TRAVEL_RH_PH
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to Pacific Heights in {TRAVEL_RH_PH} minutes and arrive at {mins_to_str(arrival_time)}.")
    itinerary.append(f"You meet Barbara from {mins_to_str(ms)} to {mins_to_str(ms + md)}.")
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible itinerary found.")

travel = {

    "Mission District": {"Haight-Ashbury": 12, "Bayview": 15, "Pacific Heights": 16, "Russian Hill": 15, "Fisherman's Wharf": 22},
    "Bayview": {"Haight-Ashbury": 19, "Mission District": 13, "Pacific Heights": 23, "Russian Hill": 23, "Fisherman's Wharf": 25},
    "Pacific Heights": {"Haight-Ashbury": 11, "Mission District": 15, "Bayview": 22, "Russian Hill": 7, "Fisherman's Wharf": 13},
    "Russian Hill": {"Haight-Ashbury": 17, "Mission District": 16, "Bayview": 23, "Pacific Heights": 7, "Fisherman's Wharf": 7},
    "Fisherman's Wharf": {"Haight-Ashbury": 22, "Mission District": 22, "Bayview": 26, "Pacific Heights": 12, "Russian Hill": 7},
}

# Friends data: (location, avail_start, avail_end, min_meeting)
def to_min(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h*60 + m

friends = {
    "Stephanie": ("Mission District", to_min("8:15"), to_min("13:45"), 90),
    "Sandra":    ("Bayview",        to_min("13:00"), to_min("19:30"), 15),
    "Richard":   ("Pacific Heights",to_min("7:15"), to_min("10:15"), 75),
    "Brian":     ("Russian Hill",   to_min("12:15"), to_min("16:00"), 120),
    "Jason":     ("Fisherman's Wharf",to_min("8:30"), to_min("17:45"), 60)
}

friend_names = list(friends.keys())
n = len(friend_names)

# ---------- Z3 Model ----------
opt = Optimize()

# Decision variables
meet = [Bool(f"meet_{i}") for i in range(n)]
s = [Int(f"s_{i}") for i in range(n)]   # meeting start
e = [Int(f"e_{i}") for i in range(n)]   # meeting end

# Ordering booleans: o_ij true if i before j
o = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i != j:
            o[(i,j)] = Bool(f"o_{i}_{j}")

# Domain constraints
START_TIME = to_min("9:00")   # 540
START_LOC = "Haight-Ashbury"

for i, name in enumerate(friend_names):
    loc, a_start, a_end, dur = friends[name]
    # If we meet, start within window and enough time for duration
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], s[i] >= a_start))
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], e[i] == s[i] + dur))
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i], e[i] <= a_end))

    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), s[i] == 0))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), e[i] == 0))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i == j: continue
        # If both meetings happen, exactly one ordering holds
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j]), Xor(o[(i,j)], o[(j,i)])))

        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j], o[(j,i)]), e[j] + travel_ji <= s[i]))

    before_others = [Not(o[(j,i)]) for j in range(n) if j != i]
    opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], *before_others), s[i] >= START_TIME + travel_start_i))

# Ensure start time is respected (cannot start before 9:00)
opt.add(START_TIME == START_TIME)  # dummy to keep solver happy

# Objective: maximize number of meetings
opt.maximize(Sum([If(meet[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n)]))

    # Gather meetings that are true
    schedule = []
    for i, name in enumerate(friend_names):

                "loc": friends[name][0],
                "start": m.evaluate(s[i]).as_long(),
                "end": m.evaluate(e[i]).as_long()
            })
    # Sort by start time
    schedule.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])

    # Build chronological statements
    def fmt(t):
        h = (t // 60) % 12
        h = 12 if h == 0 else h
        m = t % 60
        suffix = "AM" if (t // 60) < 12 else "PM"
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

    statements = []
    # start statement
    statements.append(f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}.")
    cur_time = START_TIME
    cur_loc = START_LOC

    for entry in schedule:
        # travel
        travel_time = travel[cur_loc][entry["loc"]]
        arrive = cur_time + travel_time
        statements.append(f"You travel to {entry['loc']} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        # wait if early
        if arrive < entry["start"]:
            statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(entry['start'])}.")
            cur_time = entry["start"]
        else:
            cur_time = arrive
        # meet
        statements.append(f"You meet {entry['name']} from {fmt(entry['start'])} to {fmt(entry['end'])}.")
        cur_time = entry["end"]
        cur_loc = entry["loc"]

    # Output the list
    print(statements)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(n)]  # minutes since midnight

def time_to_min(t):
    # t like "9:00AM"
    h = int(t[:-5].split(":")[0])
    m = int(t[:-5].split(":")[1])
    ampm = t[-2:]
    if ampm == "PM" and h != 12:
        h += 12
    if ampm == "AM" and h == 12:
        h = 0
    return h * 60 + m

def min_to_time(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mi = m % 60
    ampm = "AM"
    if h >= 12:
        ampm = "PM"
    if h == 0:
        h = 12
    elif h > 12:
        h -= 12
    return f"{h}:{mi:02d}{ampm}"

# Data

    "Robert":"Chinatown",
    "Jeffrey":"Union Square",
    "Carol":"Mission District",
    "Mark":"Golden Gate Park",
    "Sandra":"Nob Hill"

required = {
    "James":120,
    "Robert":90,
    "Jeffrey":120,
    "Carol":15,
    "Mark":15,
    "Sandra":15

        fj = friends[j]
        o_ij = Bool(f"order_{fi}_{fj}")   # fi before fj
        o_ji = Bool(f"order_{fj}_{fi}")   # fj before fi
        order[(fi,fj)] = o_ij
        order[(fj,fi)] = o_ji
        # If both meetings happen, exactly one direction holds
        opt.add(Implies(meet[fi] & meet[fj], Xor(o_ij, o_ji)))
        # If one of them is not meeting, direction vars are false
        opt.add(Implies(Not(meet[fi]) | Not(meet[fj]), And(Not(o_ij), Not(o_ji))))
        # Travel constraints
        travel_ij = travel[locations[fi]][locations[fj]]
        travel_ji = travel[locations[fj]][locations[fi]]
        opt.add(Implies(o_ij, end[fi] + travel_ij <= start[fj]))
        opt.add(Implies(o_ji, end[fj] + travel_ji <= start[fi]))

# Connect dummy start to first meeting
for f in friends:
    travel_start = travel[START_LOC][locations[f]]
    o = Bool(f"order_start_{f}")
    opt.add(o == BoolVal(True))  # dummy start is before any meeting that occurs
    # If meeting occurs, enforce travel from start
    opt.add(Implies(meet[f], end_dummy + travel_start <= start[f]))

        arrive = prev_end + travel_time
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {min_to_time(arrive)}.")
        if arrive < s:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {min_to_time(s)}.")
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {f} from {min_to_time(s)} to {min_to_time(e)}.")
        prev_loc = loc
        prev_end = e
    # Print the list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.", file=sys.stderr)

# Int: end time

    travel_from_start = travel[("Richmond District", loc[i])]

    # Sort chronologically
    meetings.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    # Helper to format time
    def fmt(t):
        h = (t // 60) % 12
        h = 12 if h == 0 else h
        m = t % 60
        suffix = "AM" if (t // 60) < 12 else "PM"
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

    itinerary = []

    schedule = []

            s = m.evaluate(start[i]).as_long()

            schedule.append((s, i, e))

        meet_str = f"You meet {name} from {mins_to_str(s)} to {mins_to_str(e)}."

        prev_loc = loc
        prev_end = e

    print(output)

# Helper: convert minutes since midnight to 12-hour string
def fmt(m):
    hour = (m // 60) % 24
    minute = m % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    hour12 = hour % 12
    if hour12 == 0:
        hour12 = 12
    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Locations
locs = ["Presidio", "North Beach", "Fisherman's Wharf", "Pacific Heights"]
# Travel times from Nob Hill to each location (minutes)

# Travel matrix between locations (rows and columns in same order as locs)
travel = [
    [0, 18, 19, 11],   # Presidio to others
    [7, 0, 5, 8],      # North Beach to others
    [11, 6, 0, 12],    # Fisherman's Wharf to others
    [8, 9, 13, 0]      # Pacific Heights to others
]

# Meeting data: (person, location index, avail_start, avail_end, min_duration)
friends = [
    ("Jeffrey", 0, 8*60, 10*60, 105),          # Presidio
    ("Steven", 1, 13*60+30, 22*60, 45),       # North Beach
    ("Barbara", 2, 18*60, 21*60+30, 30),     # Fisherman's Wharf
    ("John", 3, 9*60, 13*60+30, 15)           # Pacific Heights
]

solver = Optimize()

# Boolean variables: whether we meet each friend
meet = [Bool(f"meet_{i}") for i in range(len(friends))]
# Start times (in minutes) for each meeting
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(len(friends))]

# Add domain constraints
for i, (person, loc, a_start, a_end, dur) in enumerate(friends):
    # If we meet, start must be within availability window and allow full duration
    solver.add(Implies(meet[i],
        And(start[i] >= a_start,
            start[i] + dur <= a_end)))
    # If we don't meet, start can be any value (unused)
    solver.add(Implies(Not(meet[i]), start[i] == -1))

# Travel from Nob Hill (start at 9:00 AM = 540)
START_TIME = 9*60
for i, (person, loc, _, _, _) in enumerate(friends):
    travel_time = travel_from_nob[loc]
    # If we meet, must arrive after traveling from start location
    solver.add(Implies(meet[i],
        start[i] >= START_TIME + travel_time))

# Non‑overlap and travel between any two meetings
M = 10000  # big M
for i in range(len(friends)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(friends)):
        pi, li, _, _, di = friends[i][0], friends[i][1], None, None, friends[i][4]
        pj, lj, _, _, dj = friends[j][0], friends[j][1], None, None, friends[j][4]
        # ordering booleans
        order_ij = Bool(f"order_{i}_{j}")  # True if i before j
        # If both meetings happen, enforce one ordering
        solver.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j]),
            Or(order_ij, Not(order_ij))))  # just to have the var exist
        # i before j
        solver.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j], order_ij),
            start[i] + di + travel[li][lj] <= start[j]))
        # j before i
        solver.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j], Not(order_ij)),
            start[j] + dj + travel[lj][li] <= start[i]))
        # If one of them is not met, ordering irrelevant
        solver.add(Implies(Not(And(meet[i], meet[j])),
            True))

# Objective: maximize number of meetings
solver.maximize(Sum([If(m, 1, 0) for m in meet]))

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    # Gather meetings that are true
    meetings = []
    for i, (person, loc, _, _, dur) in enumerate(friends):
        if m.evaluate(meet[i]):
            st = m.evaluate(start[i]).as_long()
            meetings.append((st, person, loc, dur))
    # Sort chronologically
    meetings.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    itinerary = []
    # start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Nob Hill at {fmt(START_TIME)}.")
    cur_time = START_TIME
    cur_loc = None  # None means Nob Hill

            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(st)}.")
            cur_time = st
        else:
            cur_time = arrival
        # meeting statement
        end = st + dur
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {person} from {fmt(st)} to {fmt(end)}.")
        # update current time and location
        cur_time = end
        cur_loc = loc

    # Print the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No solution found.")

def fmt(t):
    hour = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    hour12 = hour % 12
    if hour12 == 0:
        hour12 = 12
    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

DANIEL_END = 20 * 60 + 15               # 8:15 PM

meet_start = Int('meet_start')          # time meeting with Daniel starts

from z3 import *

# Helper to convert minutes since midnight to 12‑hour string without seconds.
def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

# Travel times (minutes) between locations.
travel = {
    ("PH","NB"): 9, ("PH","FD"): 13, ("PH","AS"): 10, ("PH","MD"): 15,
    ("NB","PH"): 8, ("NB","FD"): 8, ("NB","AS"): 16, ("NB","MD"): 18,
    ("FD","PH"): 13, ("FD","NB"): 7, ("FD","AS"): 17, ("FD","MD"): 17,
    ("AS","PH"): 10, ("AS","NB"): 15, ("AS","FD"): 17, ("AS","MD"): 10,
    ("MD","PH"): 16, ("MD","NB"): 17, ("MD","FD"): 17, ("MD","AS"): 11,
}

# Boolean variables: whether we meet each friend.
H, K, B, A = Bools('H K B A')

# Start times (in minutes since midnight) for each meeting.
sH, sK, sB, sA = Ints('sH sK sB sA')

solver = Optimize()

# Domain for start times.
for sv in (sH, sK, sB, sA):
    solver.add(sv >= 0, sv < 24*60)

# ---------- Availability and minimum duration ----------
# Helen: 9:00‑17:00, 15 min
solver.add(Implies(H, sH >= 9*60 + travel[("PH","NB")]))          # travel from start to NB
solver.add(Implies(H, sH + 15 <= 17*60))

# Kevin: 10:45‑14:45, 45 min
solver.add(Implies(K, sK >= 10*60 + 45))
solver.add(Implies(K, sK + 45 <= 14*60 + 45))

# Betty: 19:00‑21:45, 90 min
solver.add(Implies(B, sB >= 19*60))
solver.add(Implies(B, sB + 90 <= 21*60 + 45))

# Amanda: 19:45‑21:00, 60 min
solver.add(Implies(A, sA >= 19*60 + 45))
solver.add(Implies(A, sA + 60 <= 21*60))

# ---------- Travel feasibility (fixed order H → K → B → A) ----------
# If Helen is attended, we must travel from PH to NB first.
solver.add(Implies(H, sH >= 9*60 + travel[("PH","NB")]))

# If Kevin is attended, travel from the previous location.
# Case 1: Helen also attended → travel NB→MD.
solver.add(Implies(And(H, K), sK >= sH + 15 + travel[("NB","MD")]))
# Case 2: Helen not attended → travel PH→MD.
solver.add(Implies(And(Not(H), K), sK >= 9*60 + travel[("PH","MD")]))

# If Betty is attended, travel from the previous location.
# Preceding could be Kevin, Helen, or none.
solver.add(Implies(And(K, B), sB >= sK + 45 + travel[("MD","FD")]))
solver.add(Implies(And(H, Not(K), B), sB >= sH + 15 + travel[("NB","FD")]))
solver.add(Implies(And(Not(H), Not(K), B), sB >= 9*60 + travel[("PH","FD")]))

# If Amanda is attended, travel from the previous location.

solver.add(Implies(And(H, Not(K), A), sA >= sH + 15 + travel[("NB","AS")]))
solver.add(Implies(And(Not(H), Not(K), A), sA >= 9*60 + travel[("PH","AS")]))

solver.add(Implies(And(K, B), sB >= sK + 45 + travel[("MD","FD")]))
solver.add(Implies(And(H, B), sB >= sH + 15 + travel[("NB","FD")]))

# ---------- Objective: maximise number of meetings ----------
solver.maximize(If(H, 1, 0) + If(K, 1, 0) + If(B, 1, 0) + If(A, 1, 0))

from z3 import *
import itertools

# Helper to format minutes since 9:00AM into 12-hour time strings
def fmt(mins):
    total = mins + 9 * 60  # convert to minutes since midnight
    hour = (total // 60) % 12
    if hour == 0:
        hour = 12
    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM" if total < 12 * 60 else "PM"
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Travel times (in minutes) as a dictionary
travel = {
    ("Financial District", "Chinatown"): 5,
    ("Financial District", "Alamo Square"): 17,
    ("Financial District", "Bayview"): 19,
    ("Financial District", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 10,
    ("Chinatown", "Financial District"): 5,
    ("Chinatown", "Alamo Square"): 17,
    ("Chinatown", "Bayview"): 22,
    ("Chinatown", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 8,
    ("Alamo Square", "Financial District"): 17,
    ("Alamo Square", "Chinatown"): 16,
    ("Alamo Square", "Bayview"): 16,
    ("Alamo Square", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 19,
    ("Bayview", "Financial District"): 19,
    ("Bayview", "Chinatown"): 18,
    ("Bayview", "Alamo Square"): 16,
    ("Bayview", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 25,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Financial District"): 11,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Chinatown"): 12,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Alamo Square"): 20,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Bayview"): 26,
}

# Friend data: name, location, availability start, availability end, required meeting duration
friends = {
    "Nancy":   ("Chinatown",       30,  270, 90),   # 9:30‑13:30
    "Mary":    ("Alamo Square",    0,   720, 75),   # 7:00‑21:00 (we start at 9:00 → 0)
    "Jessica": ("Bayview",        135,  285, 45),   # 11:15‑13:45
    "Rebecca": ("Fisherman's Wharf", 0,  90, 45),   # 7:00‑8:30 (unreachable)
}

# We try to meet the maximal subset of friends. Start with all 3 feasible friends.
candidate_names = ["Nancy", "Mary", "Jessica"]

best_schedule = None

# Try every permutation of the candidate friends
for perm in itertools.permutations(candidate_names):
    s = Solver()
    start = {}
    end = {}
    # Create start time variables for each friend in the permutation
    for name in perm:
        start[name] = Int(f"start_{name}")
        end[name] = start[name] + friends[name][3]  # duration

        avail_start = friends[name][1]
        avail_end   = friends[name][2]
        dur         = friends[name][3]

        s.add(start[name] >= avail_start)
        s.add(end[name]   <= avail_end)

    # Travel from Financial District to the first friend
    first = perm[0]
    loc_first = friends[first][0]
    travel_fd_first = travel[("Financial District", loc_first)]
    s.add(start[first] >= travel_fd_first)  # we can wait after arriving

    # Travel between successive friends
    for i in range(1, len(perm)):
        prev = perm[i-1]
        cur  = perm[i]
        loc_prev = friends[prev][0]
        loc_cur  = friends[cur][0]
        t = travel[(loc_prev, loc_cur)]
        s.add(start[cur] >= end[prev] + t)

    # No need for a final constraint (day ends after last meeting)
    if s.check() == sat:
        model = s.model()
        # Record this feasible schedule
        best_schedule = (perm, {n: model[start[n]].as_long() for n in perm})
        break  # first feasible permutation is sufficient (all are equivalent length)

# Build the itinerary list of strings
itinerary = []
itinerary.append(f"You start at Financial District at {fmt(0)}.")  # 9:00AM

if best_schedule:
    order, starts = best_schedule
    prev_end = 0  # end time of previous activity (initially 9:00)
    for name in order:
        loc = friends[name][0]
        dur = friends[name][3]
        travel_time = travel[("Financial District", loc)] if prev_end == 0 else travel[(prev_loc, loc)]
        arrival = prev_end + travel_time
        # Travel statement
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrival)}.")
        # Wait if needed
        meet_start = starts[name]
        if arrival < meet_start:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        meet_end = meet_start + dur
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
        # Update for next leg
        prev_end = meet_end
        prev_loc = loc

print(itinerary)

    # t format: "H:MMAM" or "H:MMPM"
    h = int(t[:-4].split(":")[0])
    m = int(t[:-4].split(":")[1])
    suffix = t[-2:]
    if suffix == "PM" and h != 12:
        h += 12
    if suffix == "AM" and h == 12:
        h = 0
    return h * 60 + m

    t = t.strip()
    hm, ampm = t[:-2], t[-2:]
    hour, minute = map(int, hm.split(":"))
    if ampm == "PM" and hour != 12:

    if ampm == "AM" and hour == 12:
        hour = 0
    total = hour * 60 + minute
    return total - 540  # offset from 9:00AM

from z3 import *

# Helper to format minutes since midnight into 12‑hour time strings
def fmt(t):
    hour = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    hour12 = hour % 12
    if hour12 == 0:
        hour12 = 12
    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Locations
locs = ["Union", "Nob", "Haight", "Chinatown", "Marina"]
# Directed travel times (minutes)
travel = {
    ("Union","Nob"):9, ("Union","Haight"):18, ("Union","Chinatown"):7, ("Union","Marina"):18,
    ("Nob","Union"):7, ("Nob","Haight"):13, ("Nob","Chinatown"):6, ("Nob","Marina"):11,
    ("Haight","Union"):17, ("Haight","Nob"):15, ("Haight","Chinatown"):19, ("Haight","Marina"):17,
    ("Chinatown","Union"):7, ("Chinatown","Nob"):8, ("Chinatown","Haight"):19, ("Chinatown","Marina"):12,
    ("Marina","Union"):16, ("Marina","Nob"):12, ("Marina","Haight"):16, ("Marina","Chinatown"):16,
}

# Friends data: name, location, availability start, availability end, minimum meeting duration (all minutes)
friends = [
    ("Karen",   "Nob",       21*60+15, 21*60+45, 30),   # 9:15PM‑9:45PM
    ("Joseph",  "Haight",    12*60+30, 19*60+45, 90),   # 12:30PM‑7:45PM
    ("Sandra",  "Chinatown", 7*60+15, 19*60+15, 75),   # 7:15AM‑7:15PM
    ("Nancy",   "Marina",    11*60+0, 20*60+15,105),   # 11:00AM‑8:15PM
]

# Z3 variables
starts = {name: Int(f"start_{name}") for name,_,_,_,_ in friends}
orders = {name: Int(f"order_{name}") for name,_,_,_,_ in friends}
opt = Optimize()

# Domain constraints for each friend
for name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur in friends:
    s = starts[name]
    opt.add(s >= a_start)                     # cannot start before availability
    opt.add(s + min_dur <= a_end)              # must finish before window closes
    # meeting duration is taken as the minimum required (extra waiting can be modeled by later start)
    
# Order must be a permutation of 0..3
order_vars = [orders[name] for name,_,_,_,_ in friends]
opt.add(Distinct(*order_vars))
for ov in order_vars:
    opt.add(ov >= 0, ov <= 3)

# Travel and sequencing constraints
START_UNION = 9*60  # 9:00AM
for name_i, loc_i, _, _, dur_i in friends:
    for name_j, loc_j, _, _, _ in friends:
        if name_i == name_j:
            continue
        # If i is before j in the itinerary, enforce travel time between them
        opt.add(Implies(orders[name_i] < orders[name_j],
                        starts[name_j] >= starts[name_i] + dur_i + travel[(loc_i, loc_j)]))

# First meeting must be reachable from Union at 9:00AM
for name, loc, _, _, _ in friends:
    opt.add(Implies(orders[name] == 0,
                    starts[name] >= START_UNION + travel[("Union", loc)]))

# Objective: maximise number of meetings (all four if possible)
# Since we force all start times to respect windows, simply maximise sum of 1s
opt.maximize(Sum([If(True, 1, 0) for _ in friends]))  # always 4, but keeps Optimize happy

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    # Build ordered list of (order, name)
    schedule = sorted([(m[orders[name]].as_long(), name) for name,_,_,_,_ in friends],
                      key=lambda x: x[0])
    itinerary = []
    # Start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at Union Square at {fmt(START_UNION)}.")
    cur_loc = "Union"
    cur_time = START_UNION
    for _, name in schedule:
        # retrieve data
        loc = next(loc for n, loc, _, _, _ in friends if n == name)
        start = m[starts[name]].as_long()
        # travel
        travel_time = travel[(cur_loc, loc)]
        arrive = cur_time + travel_time
        itinerary.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        # wait if we arrived early
        if arrive < start:
            itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(start)}.")
        # meeting
        dur = next(dur for n, _, _, _, dur in friends if n == name)
        end = start + dur
        itinerary.append(f"You meet {name} from {fmt(start)} to {fmt(end)}.")
        # update current location and time
        cur_loc = loc
        cur_time = end
    # Print the list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

}
# availability windows (minutes from midnight) and minimum meeting durations

    'Thomas': 15*60 + 30,      # 3:30PM

    'Laura': 8*60 + 45,       # 8:45AM
    'Betty': 18*60 + 45,      # 6:45PM
    'Patricia': 17*60 + 30    # 5:30PM
}
avail_end = {
    'Thomas': 18*60 + 30,      # 6:30PM
    'Stephanie': 21*60 + 45,  # 9:45PM
    'Laura': 16*60 + 15,      # 4:15PM
    'Betty': 21*60 + 45,      # 9:45PM

    'Thomas': 120,
    'Stephanie': 30,
    'Laura': 30,
    'Betty': 45,
    'Patricia': 45
}

    ('Fisherman\'s Wharf','Golden Gate Park'):25, ('Golden Gate Park','Fisherman\'s Wharf'):24,
    ('Fisherman\'s Wharf','Nob Hill'):11, ('Nob Hill','Fisherman\'s Wharf'):11,
    ('Fisherman\'s Wharf','Marina District'):9, ('Marina District','Fisherman\'s Wharf'):10,
    ('Fisherman\'s Wharf','Embarcadero'):8, ('Embarcadero','Fisherman\'s Wharf'):6,
    ('Bayview','Golden Gate Park'):22, ('Golden Gate Park','Bayview'):23,
    ('Bayview','Nob Hill'):20, ('Nob Hill','Bayview'):19,
    ('Bayview','Marina District'):25, ('Marina District','Bayview'):27,
    ('Bayview','Embarcadero'):19, ('Embarcadero','Bayview'):21,
    ('Golden Gate Park','Nob Hill'):20, ('Nob Hill','Golden Gate Park'):17,

    ('Golden Gate Park','Embarcadero'):25, ('Embarcadero','Golden Gate Park'):25,

    ('Nob Hill','Embarcadero'):9, ('Embarcadero','Nob Hill'):10,
    ('Marina District','Embarcadero'):14, ('Embarcadero','Marina District'):12
}
# shortcut for travel between any two locations
def t(a,b):
    return travel[(a,b)]

# ---------- Z3 Model ----------
opt = Optimize()

# Boolean: whether we meet each friend
meet = {f: Bool(f) for f in friends}
# Start and end times (int minutes from midnight)
start = {f: Int('s_'+f) for f in friends}
end   = {f: Int('e_'+f) for f in friends}

            start[f] >= avail_start[f],
            end[f]   == start[f] + min_meet[f],

        )

        prev_loc = loc[f]

    # output the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

def time_to_min(t):
    # t like "9:30AM" or "12:00PM"
    hour = int(t[:-5])
    minute = int(t[-5:-3])
    ampm = t[-2:]
    if hour == 12:
        hour = 0
    total = hour * 60 + minute
    if ampm == "PM":
        total += 12 * 60
    # shift so that 9:00AM = 0
    return total - (9 * 60)

    total = m + 9 * 60

    elif hour > 12:

# Helper to convert HH:MM strings to minutes since 9:00AM
def time_to_min(t):
    h, m = map(int, t[:-2].split(':'))
    period = t[-2:]
    if period == 'PM' and h != 12:
        h += 12
    if period == 'AM' and h == 12:
        h = 0
    return (h - 9) * 60 + m

    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

from z3 import *

# Locations
loc_names = [
    "Golden Gate Park",   # 0
    "Haight-Ashbury",     # 1
    "Sunset District",    # 2
    "Marina District",    # 3
    "Financial District", # 4
    "Union Square"        # 5
]

# Travel times (directed) in minutes
travel = [
    # to:   0   1   2   3   4   5
    [   0,  7, 10, 16, 26, 22],  # from 0 Golden Gate Park
    [   7,  0, 15, 17, 21, 17],  # from 1 Haight-Ashbury
    [  11, 15,  0, 21, 30, 30],  # from 2 Sunset District
    [  18, 16, 19,  0, 17, 16],  # from 3 Marina District
    [  23, 19, 31, 15,  0,  9],  # from 4 Financial District
    [  22, 18, 26, 18,  9,  0]   # from 5 Union Square
]

# Friends data
friends = [
    # name, location index, avail_start (min from 9:00), avail_end, min_meeting
    ("Sarah",   1, 8*60,   12*60+30, 105),   # 5:00PM=17:00 -> 8h from 9:00, 9:30PM=21:30 -> 12h30m
    ("Patricia",2, 8*60,   10*60+45, 45),    # 5:00PM to 7:45PM
    ("Matthew", 3, 0*60+15, 3*60,   15),    # 9:15AM to 12:00PM
    ("Joseph",  4, 5*60+15, 9*60+45, 30),   # 2:15PM to 6:45PM
    ("Robert",  5, 1*60+15, 12*60+45,15)    # 10:15AM to 9:45PM
]

num_f = len(friends)

# Z3 variables
meet = [Bool(f"meet_{i}") for i in range(num_f)]
start = [Int(f"start_{i}") for i in range(num_f)]

opt = Optimize()

# Add constraints for each friend
for i, (name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur) in enumerate(friends):
    # Availability window and minimum duration
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i],
                    And(start[i] >= a_start,
                        start[i] + min_dur <= a_end)))
    # Cannot start before travel from the initial location (Golden Gate Park)
    opt.add(Implies(meet[i],
                    start[i] >= travel[0][loc]))

# Non‑overlap constraints using ordering booleans
for i in range(num_f):
    for j in range(i+1, num_f):
        before_ij = Bool(f"before_{i}_{j}")  # True => i before j
        # If both meetings happen, enforce one ordering direction
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j]),
                        Or(before_ij, Not(before_ij))))
        # If i before j, enforce travel time
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j], before_ij),
                        start[j] >= start[i] + friends[i][4] + travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))
        # If j before i, enforce travel time
        opt.add(Implies(And(meet[i], meet[j], Not(before_ij)),
                        start[i] >= start[j] + friends[j][4] + travel[friends[j][1]][friends[i][1]]))

# Objective: maximise number of meetings
opt.maximize(Sum([If(m, 1, 0) for m in meet]))

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    # Gather meetings that are selected
    selected = []
    for i in range(num_f):
        if m.evaluate(meet[i]):
            s = m.evaluate(start[i]).as_long()
            selected.append((s, i))
    # Sort by start time
    selected.sort()
    # Build itinerary
    itinerary = []
    # start statement
    itinerary.append(f"You start at {loc_names[0]} at 9:00AM.")
    cur_loc = 0
    cur_time = 0  # minutes from 9:00
    for s, i in selected:
        name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur = friends[i]
        # Travel to this location
        travel_time = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        arrive = cur_time + travel_time
        travel_stmt = f"You travel to {loc_names[loc]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at " \
                      f"{(lambda t: (t//60+9, t%60))(arrive)[0]:02d}:{(lambda t: (t//60+9, t%60))(arrive)[1]:02d}."
        # Convert arrival time to 12‑hour format
        def fmt(mins):
            hour = 9 + mins // 60
            minute = mins % 60
            suffix = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
            hour12 = hour % 12
            if hour12 == 0:
                hour12 = 12
            return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"
        travel_stmt = f"You travel to {loc_names[loc]} in {travel_time} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}."
        itinerary.append(travel_stmt)
        # Wait if we arrive early
        if arrive < s:
            wait_stmt = f"You wait until {fmt(s)}."
            itinerary.append(wait_stmt)
        # Meeting statement
        meet_stmt = f"You meet {name} from {fmt(s)} to {fmt(s + min_dur)}."
        itinerary.append(meet_stmt)
        # Update current location and time
        cur_loc = loc
        cur_time = s + min_dur
    # Print the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")

    if hour == 0:
        hour = 12
    minute = total_minutes % 60
    suffix = "AM" if (total_minutes // 60) < 12 else "PM"
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m%60:02d}{suffix}"

# Constants (minutes since midnight)

JESS_START = 15 * 60 + 30      # 3:30 PM = 930
JESS_END   = 16 * 60 + 45      # 4:45 PM = 1005

CARL_START = 11 * 60 + 30      # 11:30 AM = 690
CARL_END   = 15 * 60           # 3:00 PM = 900
CARL_MIN   = 60

TR_R_M = 9
TR_P_R = 12
TR_P_M = 6
TR_M_R = 11
TR_M_P = 7

meet_C = Bool('meet_C')              # meet Carol?

ts_RP = Int('ts_RP')
ts_MP = Int('ts_MP')
ts_PM = Int('ts_PM')

arr_P = Int('arr_P')

J_end   = Int('J_end')

C_end   = Int('C_end')

    total = 9 * 60 + m
    hour24 = (total // 60) % 24
    minute = total % 60
    suffix = "AM" if hour24 < 12 else "PM"
    hour12 = hour24 % 12
    if hour12 == 0:
        hour12 = 12
    return f"{hour12}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Travel times (in minutes)
t_PH_Pres = 11
t_PH_Mar = 6
t_Pres_Mar = 10
t_Mar_Pres = 10
t_Mar_PH = 7
t_Pres_PH = 11

j_end_avail   = 435     # 4:15PM
k_start_avail = 390     # 3:30PM
k_end_avail   = 465     # 4:45PM

# Minimum meeting durations

k_min = 45

# Decision variables
meet_J = Bool('meet_J')
meet_K = Bool('meet_K')
order_J_first = Bool('order_J_first')  # True -> Jason first, False -> Kenneth first

start_J = Int('start_J')   # start time of Jason meeting (minutes since 9:00)
start_K = Int('start_K')   # start time of Kenneth meeting

s = Optimize()

# Domain constraints
s.add(Implies(meet_J, start_J >= j_start_avail))
s.add(Implies(meet_J, start_J + j_min <= j_end_avail))
s.add(Implies(meet_K, start_K >= k_start_avail))
s.add(Implies(meet_K, start_K + k_min <= k_end_avail))

# Non‑overlap constraints
s.add(Implies(And(meet_J, meet_K),
              Or(
                  # Jason finishes before Kenneth starts
                  start_J + j_min <= start_K,
                  # Kenneth finishes before Jason starts
                  start_K + k_min <= start_J
              )))

# Travel feasibility based on order

                  start_J >= t_PH_Pres,

                  start_K >= start_J + j_min + t_Pres_Mar

              And(
                  start_K >= t_PH_Mar,
                  start_J >= start_K + k_min + t_Mar_Pres

from z3 import *

# Helper to format minutes since midnight into 12-hour time strings
def fmt(mins):
    hour = (mins // 60) % 12
    if hour == 0:
        hour = 12
    minute = mins % 60
    suffix = "AM" if mins < 12 * 60 else "PM"
    return f"{hour}:{minute:02d}{suffix}"

# Locations
SUNSET = "Sunset District"
NORTH = "North Beach"
CHIN = "Chinatown"
RUS = "Russian Hill"

# Travel times (minutes) as a dictionary keyed by (from, to)
travel = {
    (SUNSET, CHIN): 30, (SUNSET, RUS): 24, (SUNSET, NORTH): 29,
    (CHIN, SUNSET): 29, (CHIN, RUS): 7,  (CHIN, NORTH): 3,
    (RUS, SUNSET): 23,  (RUS, CHIN): 9,  (RUS, NORTH): 5,
    (NORTH, SUNSET): 27,(NORTH, CHIN): 6, (NORTH, RUS): 4,
}

# Meeting data
friends = {
    "Melissa": {"loc": NORTH, "avail_start": 8*60+15, "avail_end": 13*60+30, "duration": 105},
    "Anthony": {"loc": CHIN, "avail_start": 13*60+15, "avail_end": 14*60+30, "duration": 60},
    "Rebecca": {"loc": RUS, "avail_start": 19*60+30, "avail_end": 21*60+15, "duration": 105},
}

# Z3 variables for meeting start times
s_M = Int('s_M')  # Melissa
s_A = Int('s_A')  # Anthony
s_R = Int('s_R')  # Rebecca

solver = Solver()

# Start time at Sunset District
start_time = 9*60  # 9:00 AM -> 540 minutes

# Constraints for Melissa
solver.add(s_M >= max(friends["Melissa"]["avail_start"], start_time + travel[(SUNSET, NORTH)]))
solver.add(s_M + friends["Melissa"]["duration"] <= friends["Melissa"]["avail_end"])

# Constraints for Anthony (must come after Melissa + travel)
solver.add(s_A >= s_M + friends["Melissa"]["duration"] + travel[(NORTH, CHIN)])
solver.add(s_A >= friends["Anthony"]["avail_start"])
solver.add(s_A + friends["Anthony"]["duration"] <= friends["Anthony"]["avail_end"])

# Constraints for Rebecca (must come after Anthony + travel)
solver.add(s_R >= s_A + friends["Anthony"]["duration"] + travel[(CHIN, RUS)])
solver.add(s_R >= friends["Rebecca"]["avail_start"])
solver.add(s_R + friends["Rebecca"]["duration"] <= friends["Rebecca"]["avail_end"])

# All start times must be within the day (0..24*60)
for var in (s_M, s_A, s_R):
    solver.add(var >= 0, var <= 24*60)

# Solve
if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    sM = m[s_M].as_long()
    sA = m[s_A].as_long()
    sR = m[s_R].as_long()

    itinerary = []

    # Start
    itinerary.append(f"You start at {SUNSET} at {fmt(start_time)}.")

    # Travel to North Beach (Melissa)
    arr_M = start_time + travel[(SUNSET, NORTH)]
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {NORTH} in {travel[(SUNSET, NORTH)]} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr_M)}.")
    if sM > arr_M:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(sM)}.")
    # Meet Melissa
    end_M = sM + friends["Melissa"]["duration"]
    itinerary.append(f"You meet Melissa from {fmt(sM)} to {fmt(end_M)}.")

    # Travel to Chinatown (Anthony)
    arr_A = end_M + travel[(NORTH, CHIN)]
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {CHIN} in {travel[(NORTH, CHIN)]} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr_A)}.")
    if sA > arr_A:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(sA)}.")
    # Meet Anthony
    end_A = sA + friends["Anthony"]["duration"]
    itinerary.append(f"You meet Anthony from {fmt(sA)} to {fmt(end_A)}.")

    # Travel to Russian Hill (Rebecca)
    arr_R = end_A + travel[(CHIN, RUS)]
    itinerary.append(f"You travel to {RUS} in {travel[(CHIN, RUS)]} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr_R)}.")
    if sR > arr_R:
        itinerary.append(f"You wait until {fmt(sR)}.")
    # Meet Rebecca
    end_R = sR + friends["Rebecca"]["duration"]
    itinerary.append(f"You meet Rebecca from {fmt(sR)} to {fmt(end_R)}.")

    # Print the itinerary list
    print(itinerary)
else:
    print("No feasible schedule found.")
